column1: # Derived-consistency map (0.0.43, research/c43-derived-consistency.md section 2).  path glob -> gate suite that
# regenerates or checks the derived file.  Read by release/tools/derivedcheck.py.  A row is a claim by the owner,
# not a generator: the suite named must exist in tests/gatedeps.json (fail closed otherwise).
# c43: the manifest also fingerprints exec/parse2 tables (d4246b51 changed librarytypedwrap-* without a refresh and no derived check fired)
# c43 R1: E3 register frames -- a parse2 table cut must keep every save/restore frame paired and its partial saves declared
# 0.0.43 seed C references (python module <-> its seed C port, read by the same checks)
# 0.0.43: reviewed_trees snapshots are derived from these trees; a change must carry the refreshed snapshot
# seedmemory (c43 readset): the reference key covers only the files the measured routes read, listed in
# tests/seedmemory-reads.tsv.  The check is seconds; it is red only when a read file moves the pinned key.
# When the read set itself changes, re-run strace over the 60 routes (research/c43-seedmemory-readset.md)
# Reproducer: tests/seedmemoryevidence.py; 30 gen + eight parse2 routes, each C/P trace and direct C RSS.
# unisa-gold-opinfo-label and unisa-vm: hand-copied tape op tables (seed C ports) must follow unisa/tape.py SHAPE
# (c43, opinfo_label red: .libraryfn was missing from two copies).  A new copy must be added here.
# c43 (9645c6db): unisa/tape.py SHAPE feeds the derived gold tables, the built weights and the kernel, and the
# docs tables. A change to SHAPE must re-run the chain: gold-export, build-weights, emit-kernel, docs.
# c43 (1d1bf3a1 follow-up): weights/gold feeds facts (exec/facts/opt-gen.tsv is exported from opinfo.tsv etc.),
# and the reviewed_trees snapshot covers kernel/ and weights/ (see gatedeps compilercheck.reviewed_trees).
# c43 S: stage-contract-e1e3 is NOT mapped here: it needs a product built from the changed tree, which a derived
# check (clean export, stale root product) does not have; its STALE guard runs in the gate with MODEL_COM.
# Inventory output derives from script membership, root commands, transitive source refs and dispositions.
# Broad release trigger is conservative; inventory reads tests/release.sh as a root.
# S2/0.0.43 pp-leaf seal (tests/seals/exec-pp-literals): every file the sealed closure reads (dependencies.tsv,
# closure.expected.tsv) plus the seal tools and the reseal recipe map to pp-leaf-seal (declared in gatedeps).
